scenes.title: An agent that runs commands needs somewhere to run them
scenes.caption: Its own container, behind the Hub's login.
scenes.narration: An agent that runs commands needs somewhere safe to do it. OpenClaw runs in its own container, and the Hub's authenticated proxy sits in front of its gateway.

scenes.title: OpenClaw
scenes.caption: OpenClaw, installed from the Hub market.
scenes.narration: This is OpenClaw, set up for Companion Hub.

scenes.title: First run is a form
scenes.caption: No onboarding command to run.
scenes.narration: First run is a setup page. Add your provider keys there. There is no interactive onboarding command, and the gateway token is managed for you.

scenes.caption: It opens ready to chat, with starter prompts.
scenes.narration: Then it opens on a chat, ready to go, with a few starter prompts to try.

shots.url: OpenClaw, installed from the Hub market
shots.alt: The OpenClaw chat view: an Assistant marked Ready to chat, four suggested prompts, and a composer with a model picker.

scenes.title: A toolbox that survives updates
scenes.caption: What it installs under /data stays.
scenes.narration: Inside the sandbox it has Python, Node, Homebrew and a headless browser. What it installs under its data folder persists across app updates.

scenes.title: Memory, if you connect it
scenes.caption: Wake-up messages are left out.
scenes.narration: Give it a Companion Memory address and key, and its memory moves there. Each finished turn is saved. The Hub's own wake-up messages are left out, so memory never files them as you.

scenes.title: Destructive actions ask first
scenes.caption: Queued as an approval card for the owner.
scenes.narration: It can list Companion's intents and run them by name. Destructive or external ones are queued as an approval card for the owner.

scenes.title: Keep it behind the proxy
scenes.caption: A container alone does not make a gateway safe.
scenes.narration: One rule. Keep the gateway on a private network or behind the Hub's proxy. A container alone does not make an agent safe to expose.

items.label: Gateway
items.value: private, or behind the Hub proxy
